name: F01 commonmarkTagLine: the indent loop reads up to five spaces
why: equivalent: a fourth space stops the loop at 4 and `lt > 3` refuses it, and a fifth space does the same from 5; no line is read differently (argued by reading, then run in memory against 12,280,240 lines of the oracle corpora with no difference)

name: F02 commonmarkTagLine: the indent loop reads up to three spaces
why: equivalent, and first labelled killed by reading (Learning 887): with three spaces read the loop stops at index 3, where the `<` stands, and a fourth space is left at index 3 and refused by `charCodeAt(lt) !== 60`; the bound is carried twice. Found by running the mutant against 12,280,240 oracle lines

name: F03 commonmarkTagLine: four spaces of indent are allowed

name: F04 commonmarkTagLine: the line must NOT start with `<` after the indent

name: F05 commonmarkTagLine: the closing and the open branch swapped
why: a closing tag is read as an open one and the reverse: the stated rows

name: F07 commonmarkTagLine: an open tag name is looked for one character late
